english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for a desire to eat or drink.
Use this for appetite or a taste for food and, by extension, other things.

examples.english: I don't have much appetite today.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 wai6 hau2

examples.english: I don't have much stomach for food today.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 taai3 jit6 ngo5 mou5 mat1 wai6 hau2
